messages:
carla.m: Deploy bot flagged elevated 5xx rate on eu-west1 canary for service 'inference-api', version 1.2.3-hotfix-1. rolling back candidate suggested. need quick decision, cc @alice.h @benj
release-bot: [automated] Canary failure threshold exceeded (5xx_rate > 3%) on eu-west1. Canary traffic at 10%. Suggested action: pin to v1.2.2 or rollforward to v1.2.3-hotfix-2.
benj: can you paste the short logs? is it timeout or stacktrace?
carla.m: short logs: ```ERROR TokenizerTimeout: shard-7 timeout after 250ms
  at model-serving/kv_cache.js:42
  at gpu-serve:batchLoop```
alice.h: looks like an IO timeout spike. How widespread? Metrics?
dan.k: latency spikes only on longer sequences (>1024). small sequences fine. could be kv cache regression in hotfix-1.
carla.m: agree. risk of rollback (pin v1.2.2) is reduced perf for some recent prompt shapes but stable. rollforward path: build hotfix-2 (patch kv cache bump) — we have a candidate image ready now.
release_manager: we have a 30min change window starting now? ops said 15m emergency window ok. need at least 2 approvals to expedite.
benj: i'm +1 for rollforward to hotfix-2 if we can canary at 5% first and monitor 10m.
alice.h: +1. if metrics look green at 10m, approve full rollout. also update release notes and post-mortem checklist.
carla.m: can we do a quick controlled canary: lower to 5% and increase CPU headroom? command: ```redwoodctl deploy --service=inference-api --to=1.2.3-hotfix-2 --canary=5 --region=eu-west1 --health-check=10m```
release-bot: [automated] Deploy request recorded by carla.m. Change window: emergency 15m. Notifying oncall.
dan.k: oncall acked, watching logs. I'll hold rollback window open for 20m.
benj: rolling canary now. pinging infra to temporarily raise batch timeout to 400ms for the canary.
release-bot: [automated] Canary started: 1.2.3-hotfix-2 @ 5% eu-west1.
carla.m: initial 3m checks: 5xx rate down to 0.8%, p95 latency dropped ~30ms.
alice.h: good sign. continue 10m observation. I retract rollback for now.
benj: after 12m still stable. i'm +1 for progressive rollout to 50% then full if green.
release_manager: approved expedited rollforward to hotfix-2. documenting decision in release notes and changelog: "Fix kv-cache timeouts for long sequences".
carla.m: executing progressive rollout to 50% now. command: ```redwoodctl deploy --service=inference-api --to=1.2.3-hotfix-2 --canary=50 --region=eu-west1```
release-bot: [automated] Rollout to 50% initiated. Monitoring traces and errors.
dan.k: monitoring traces, all looks nominal. keeping rollback window until full rollout completes.
carla.m: full rollout queued. will post final status and updated release notes once finished. thanks for fast approvals :thumbsup:
release-bot: [automated] Full rollout complete: 1.2.3-hotfix-2 deployed to eu-west1. Change window closed.
carla.m: final: postmortem TODO assigned to me. I'll add notes about adding KV cache integration test for >1024 tokens and update runbooks.
